claimText: Anna University Thiruvallur district affiliated-college list includes Easwari Engineering College (Autonomous), examination code 3106 and TNEA code 1304.

Same official table: UG boys/girls permanent hostels; veg/non-veg mess. Annual mess INR 90,000 each, annual room INR 80,000 boys / 89,000 girls, annual electricity INR 6,000 each.
